# Monospace from Directus

The governed API layer for every app, person, and agent

Visit Website

Product screenshot

## About

Monospace sits between enterprise data and everyone who builds on it. Connect any data source, and your developers, business teams, and AI agents get live, read-write access to it. All under the same granular permissions model, with no data copied or moved. Your oldest databases weren't built with AI or modern apps in mind. Monospace generates interfaces directly from them, as they are, introspecting the schema and queries in real time, so they don’t need to be rebuilt.

# Overview

How Directus licensing works, how to add a license, and what happens when you exceed your plan.

Directus is licensed under the Monospace Sustainable Core License (MSCL). Self-hosted instances without a license run on the core tier. To unlock additional capabilities or higher limits, add a license to your instance.

Free commercial use is available through the Open Innovation Grant for entities with less than $5M in annual revenue and fewer than 50 employees. Eligibility is assessed based on the legal entities whose representatives log into the Directus Studio. Full terms are set out in the grant usage agreement.
